# City of Chicago

> > Official website of the City of Chicago providing information on historic landmarks, architectural preservation, and city services.

The City of Chicago maintains detailed records of designated landmarks and historic districts, including architectural styles like Gothic Revival, Queen Anne, and Richardsonian Romanesque. The site documents Chicago's rich architectural heritage and residential development history, particularly in neighborhoods like Lakeview.

## Key Topics

- Chicago Landmarks
- Historic Districts
- Arlington & Roslyn Place District
- Lakeview Neighborhood
- Residential Architecture
- Late 19th Century Development
- Gothic Revival Architecture
- Queen Anne Style
- Richardsonian Romanesque
- Lakefront Development
- Architectural Preservation
- Clark Street
- Theurer-Wrigley House

## Historic Districts & Landmarks

- [Chicago Landmarks - District Details](https://webapps1.chicago.gov/landmarksweb/web/districtdetails.htm?disId=2): Arlington & Roslyn Place historic district details in Lakeview
